title: County Commissioners Donate Turkeys to Children's Advocacy Center for Thanksgiving
excerpt: Webb County Commissioners John Galo and Jesse Gonzalez donated turkeys to the Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County, helping the center and its client families ahead of Thanksgiving.
content:
The Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County thanked Webb County Commissioners John Galo and Jesse Gonzalez for donating turkeys to the center ahead of Thanksgiving.

“It is turkey season!” the center wrote in a post Thursday, Nov. 20, thanking both commissioners for their generosity and for thinking of the center and its client families.

Galo represents Precinct 3 on the Webb County Commissioners Court.

The center said the donation benefits the center and the families it serves.

Source: Children's Advocacy Center of Laredo-Webb County, Nov. 20, 2026.
